name: The same number of senators voted for and against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2025-02-05.168.2) introduced by NSW Senator [Ross Cadell](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/nsw/ross_cadell) (Nationals) on behalf of West Australian Senator [Dean Smith](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/wa/dean_smith) (Liberal), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *That, if the [Treasury Laws Amendment (Miscellaneous Measures) Bill 2024](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7302) has not been finally considered by the adjournment on Thursday, 6 February 2025 then:* > > *(a) the bill be listed as the first item of government business on Monday, 10 February 2025;* > > *(b) the questions on all remaining stages of the bill be put at 11 am; and* > > *(c) paragraph (b) operate as a limitation of debate under standing order 142*
